meta.description:
The most talented young fighters in mixed martial arts face off to see who emerges victorious in Combate Global.

Shows: Combate Global 2023, Combate Global 2022, Combate Global 2024, Combate Global 2022: Vazquez vs Perez, Combate Global 2023: Ibarra vs Davila
